body:
The assumption from `memcpy` as used here isn't that it's trivially copyable, it's that it's trivially relocatable. The old data isn't used anymore after the `memcpy` so it isn't a copy at all.

See also https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/100509

The fact that there isn't a bug associated with the PR but only a theoretical issue should tip you off that this isn't a problem in practice.
